description: Derives monoids from list-monad algebras and free monoids from the free-forgetful adjunction. Lawvere theories and finitary monads organize equational operations and substitution; finite powersets, nonempty lists, and Kleisli versus Eilenberg–Moore constructions illustrate how changing the monad changes its algebras.
